en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3375 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"The guardian of the orphan is in the position of his father; he takes the preemption (shufah) for him if he has a desire for it."
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) also said: "The absentee has the right of preemption (shufah)."
